text.description_html:
Bommer BB5022-045R-630 4-1/2" Stainless Steel Swing Clear Hinge

Standard duty .134" thickness ball bearing stainless steel swing clear hinge. Standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design, Brushed Stainless Steel finish. For standard weight / average frequency use doors with square door edge.

Swing clear hinges are used when conditions require the door to completely clear the opening at 90 degrees. ADA compliant and made in the USA.

Specifications: for Bommer BB5022-045R-630 Swing Clear Hinge

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Two (2) Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Thickness: 0.134" (Standard Duty)
  • Hinge Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Non-Handed
  • For Square Door Edge
  • Non-Rising Removable Stainless Steel Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A8122
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless
  • Bommer BB5022-045-045R Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Package with stainless steel machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually (1 door hinge)

**These hinges are normally special order 3-4 weeks to ship.
